meta.title: Buyer discovers suppliers with Vendor Finder and invites one
gaps: The catalog cannot verify that the invited vendor is subsequently treated as a prospective supplier.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot verify that the invited vendor is subsequently treated as a prospective supplier.

args.goal: Open the Vendors tab, click the ✨ Vendor Finder button next to Start Onboarding, click a ready-made prompt in the Smart Supplier Scout side panel, click the blue search icon, select a vendor card, click Invite All Selected, and stop with the vendor cards and invitation-sent confirmation visible

steps.note: Performs the unavailable Vendor Finder UI flow and requires the screen to show supplier cards and the resulting confirmation.
